        ORG #6000
CNT     EQU 5
LAB     LD A,7*3+1/2
        LD HL,LAB+2
        LD HL,1+2*255
        DB 1,2,3,#FF,%101,'A'
        DB 'HELLO',#00
        DB #AA DUP 3
        DW #1234,LAB,$
        DW #A0ED DUP 2
        LD A,'1'
        CP '5'
        LD BC,0-8
        LD A,100/7
        LD A,#F0-#10
        LD (IX+5),A
        LD A,(IY+0)
        SLI B
        JR LAB
        DJNZ $
        EX AF,AF'
        LD B,CNT ; COMMENT
L_X     NOP
        ENT
        RET
